summary: Ascent Industries Co. filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its credit facility in connection with its previously announced acquisition of Midwest Graphic Sales, Inc. and Sigma Coatings, Inc. The amendment adds a wholly-owned subsidiary, Ascent Chemicals - MGS, LLC, as a loan party and makes conforming changes. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed in this filing. The transaction is funded via existing credit resources. The acquisition itself appears to be a bolt-on in the chemicals distribution space. Watch for closing conditions and integration updates in subsequent filings.
